message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "verify_bilateral_hilar_findings_with_lateral_view", "description": "When a chest X-ray classifier identifies high-confidence masses in bilateral hilar regions, verify the finding using lateral views to distinguish symmetric adenopathy from malignancy.", "applicable_conditions": "Chest imaging tasks where automated classifiers detect bilateral hilar abnormalities or masses, requiring differentiation between lymphadenopathy (e.g., sarcoidosis) and neoplastic processes.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns a high-confidence 'Mass' finding for bilateral hilar structures: (1) Do not accept the label as definitive malignancy; (2) Call `chest_xray_report_generator` specifically on lateral views; (3) Analyze the report for symmetry of hilar enlargement and absence of parenchymal invasion; (4) Prioritize the morphological pattern of symmetric adenopathy over the generic classifier label if lateral view confirms symmetry."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
